title: Postage for a Large Envelope in Canada
description: A 9×12 flat envelope is oversize Lettermail: $2.61 up to 100 g, three Permanent stamps, and more as the weight climbs to 500 g. Rates and stamp counts.
keywords: how many stamps for a large envelope canada
answer: A large flat envelope, such as 9 × 12 inches, is oversize Lettermail. It costs $2.61 up to 100 grams, $4.29 up to 200 grams, and $7.36 at the 500 gram limit. In Permanent stamps ($1.24 each) that is three stamps up to 100 grams.

blocks.p: Two Permanent stamps ($2.48) fall $0.13 short of the first band, so a flat envelope needs three even when it is light.

The largest Lettermail item is 380 × 270 × 20 mm and 500 g. A 9 × 12 inch envelope (about 229 × 305 mm) fits. A thicker package, or anything over 500 g, is no longer Lettermail and must go as a parcel. Non-standard items have a minimum weight of 3 g and oversize items 5 g.

sections.h2: Why a flat envelope costs more

blocks.p: A folded letter in a standard envelope qualifies for the lowest rate. A flat sheet in a 9 × 12 envelope does not, because it is larger than 245 × 156 mm. Canada Post prices it as non-standard or oversize Lettermail, and the envelope itself costs more than a #10.

Flat suits documents that must not be folded: certificates, drawings, and anything you want to arrive pressed. A long letter can also be cheaper flat than folded across several envelopes. sendletter offers 9 × 12 and 10 × 15 flat mailers; the [cost breakdown](/blog/what-an-online-letter-costs) shows how each is priced.
